purpose: Check a published rent; no new modeling inputs
definition: Market rental rates by approval date; rent agreed between owners and tenants, declared by the flat owner; accuracy not verified by HDB.
matching: Approval month, town, block, flat type and monthly rent match; DEPOT RD corresponds to Depot Road.
limits: The API _id is a public table row identifier, not a listing or unit identifier.
No unit number, listing URL, lease details or room/whole-flat indicator is published here.
Floor area, flat model and lease commencement year in the competition row are absent from this public table.
A matching published record does not establish the original advertisement, rental coverage or a confirmed recording error.
The full competition dataset provenance has not been established by this single-record check.
